mode.title: Mode
enumTitles: Cross-venue spread: one row per Kalshi/Polymarket pair
mode.description: 'spread' pairs the same question on both exchanges (weather brackets, Fed, elections, sports...) and reports the price gap and the executable edge. Both sources are always fetched in spread mode.

status.title: Market status
status.description: Open markets (tradeable now), settled/closed markets (with results), or both.

searchQueries.title: Search keywords
searchQueries.description: Case-insensitive keywords matched against market title, event title and series title. Leave empty to return the top markets by 24h volume.

weatherPreset.title: Weather markets preset
weatherPreset.description: Kalshi 'Climate and Weather' series (daily high/low temperature brackets, rain, hurricanes) plus Polymarket weather tag. Combine with 'Cities' to narrow.

cities.title: Cities (weather preset)
cities.description: Filter weather series by city name in the series title, e.g. NYC, Chicago, Miami, Austin, Denver, Los Angeles.

kalshiSeriesTickers.title: Kalshi series tickers
kalshiSeriesTickers.description: e.g. KXHIGHNY (NYC daily high temp), KXFEDDECISION. Fastest way to target a market family.

kalshiEventTickers.title: Kalshi event tickers
kalshiEventTickers.description: e.g. KXHIGHNY-26SEP02. Returns all bracket markets in the event.

polymarketTags.title: Polymarket tags
polymarketTags.description: Tag slugs or numeric tag IDs, e.g. politics, crypto, fomc, weather, nba.

polymarketEventSlugs.title: Polymarket event slugs
polymarketEventSlugs.description: From the URL polymarket.com/event/<slug>. Returns every market in the event.

minVolume24h.title: Min 24h volume
minVolume24h.description: Drop markets below this 24h volume (contracts for Kalshi, USD for Polymarket).

minLiquidity.title: Min liquidity (USD)
minLiquidity.description: Drop markets below this resting liquidity.

minOpenInterest.title: Min open interest (Kalshi)
minOpenInterest.description: Drop Kalshi markets with open interest below this many contracts.

settledLookbackDays.title: Settled lookback (days)
settledLookbackDays.description: For status 'settled' or 'all': how far back to fetch resolved markets.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Order of rows before the "Max markets" cap is applied.

maxItems.title: Max markets
maxItems.description: Cap on dataset rows. Applied after filtering and sorting.

includeOrderbook.title: Include orderbook
includeOrderbook.description: Attach top-of-book depth (bids/asks) per market. One extra API call per market. Billed as enriched record.

includeRecentTrades.title: Include recent trades
includeRecentTrades.description: Attach the most recent fills per market. One extra API call per market. Billed as enriched record.

tradesLimit.title: Trades per market
tradesLimit.description: How many recent fills to attach per market when "Include recent trades" is on.

orderbookDepth.title: Orderbook depth
orderbookDepth.description: Price levels per side to attach when "Include orderbook" is on.

changesOnly.title: Changes only (monitor mode)
changesOnly.description: Remember values between runs. Markets mode reports new/moved YES prices. Spread mode reports only positive executable edges with two live legs, when the net edge is new or moves by the threshold.

minPriceMovePts.title: Min monitored move (points)
minPriceMovePts.description: Minimum move in probability points (0-100): YES price in markets mode, executable net edge after fees in spread mode.

monitorStoreName.title: Monitor store name
monitorStoreName.description: Named key-value store that holds the last-seen prices. Use different names for different watchlists.

includeRaw.title: Include raw API objects
includeRaw.description: Attach the untouched upstream market object under 'raw'.

pairs.title: Explicit pairs (spread mode)
pairs.description: KALSHI_TICKER=polymarket-market-slug (or =0x condition id). Always paired, no matching needed. Example: KXHIGHNY-26SEP08-T80=will-the-highest-temperature-in-new-york-city-be-between-80-81f-on-september-8

minSpreadPts.title: Min spread (points, spread mode)
minSpreadPts.description: Only report pairs whose absolute Kalshi-minus-Polymarket gap is at least this many probability points.

minMatchScore.title: Min match score (spread mode)
minMatchScore.description: Title similarity (0-100) required to auto-pair an event across venues. Lower to see more, less certain pairs; every row carries its match_score.

spreadPoolSize.title: Polymarket candidate pool (spread mode)
spreadPoolSize.description: How many top-volume Polymarket markets to consider for pairing when no Polymarket filter is set.
